Play: On: run the simulation. Off: freeze the flock.
Reset: Pulse: re-seed positions from the in1 points (or the demo scatter) and randomize velocities from Seed.
Maxboids: Maximum number of boids; only the first Maxboids input points flock. Cost grows with the square of the count.
Speed: Simulation time scale. 1 = normal, 0 = stopped, 2 = twice as fast.
Seed: Random seed for the initial velocities. Takes effect on Reset.
Separation: Weight of steering away from close neighbours. Higher = boids keep more distance.
Alignment: Weight of steering to match the heading of nearby boids. Higher = more uniform flow.
Cohesion: Weight of steering toward the centre of nearby boids. Higher = tighter clumps. Boosted by band1 on in2.
Sepradius: Neighbour distance for Separation, in world units.
Aliradius: Neighbour distance for Alignment, in world units.
Cohradius: Neighbour distance for Cohesion, in world units.
Maxspeed: Upper speed limit, in world units per second.
Minspeed: Lower speed limit, in world units per second. Keeps boids from stalling.
Maxforce: Limit on the total steering force per boid. Lower = wider, lazier turns.
Wander: Amount of random turning. 0 = none. Boosted by beat on in2.
Boundsize: Half extent of the cubic bounding box, in world units.
Boundmode: wrap: boids leaving one side re-enter on the opposite side. bounce: boids reflect off the walls.
Obstacle: Enable a spherical obstacle that boids steer around.
Obstaclepos: Obstacle centre position in world units.
Boidsize: Size of the instanced cone on each boid, in world units.
Color1: Colour of slow boids; also tinted by heading.
Color2: Colour of fast boids; also tinted by heading.
